mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP2C9 and potentially glucuronidation pathways, increasing valproic acid levels and toxicity risk; valproic acid may inhibit lopinavir metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor valproic acid serum concentrations closely and adjust dose accordingly; consider therapeutic drug monitoring for both agents; assess for signs of valproic acid toxicity including tremor, sedation, and hepatotoxicity.
